about: Experience SkyGunner™ originally released on the PlayStation®2 console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
• Powerful game engine allows for expansive environments and an insane amount of on-screen action!
• Choose from three Skygunners; Ciel, Copain and Femme. Take on a multitude of spectacular missions!
• Take advantage of the intricate scoring system to unlock hidden secrets and modes!
• Choose between the original Japanese and the English voice-overs that are interwoven throughout the action!

This title has been converted from the PlayStation®2 version to the PlayStation®4 and PlayStation®5 consoles and provides newly added features. Consequently, there may be times where the title plays differently from the PlayStation®2 version, or where some features may cause the title to not function properly. This version does not support the PlayStation®2 console’s peripherals, therefore some functionality may not be available.
Remote Play allows users to connect to and play games on their PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5 using a mobile device, PC, or another PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5.
summary: Experience SkyGunner™ originally released on the PlayStation®2 console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
